name: claude-delegate
description: Ask Claude for an independent second opinion from inside Codex. Routes through PolyFlare for multi-seat balancing, per-model cap steering and usage telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Second opinion from Claude, inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Exposes an ask_claude tool that runs Claude Code headless and returns its verbatim answer. Intended for review, architecture critique and subtle-bug hunting, where judgement from outside the current model family is the point. Read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review the concurrency in this file
Get a second opinion on this architecture
Have Claude look for subtle correctness bugs in my recent changes
